applicable_to: short-term rental property owners, managers, and on-site employees

required_content: requirements for sex trafficking prevention and response

harbor_alliance_actions.action: Complete the required sex trafficking prevention and response training
harbor_alliance_actions.details: All hotel, motel, and short-term rental property owners, managers, and on-site employees must complete this training annually.
Managers and owners are required to display a back-of-house poster that outlines the requirements for sex trafficking prevention and response.

notes: Training materials will be available in Spanish, Hmong, and Somali starting late fall 2023/early 2024.
Licensees (owners, managers) are required to pay for the costs of compliance, such as printing posters.
